description.default: Short-drama panel for Hongguo: recommendations, rankings, category filters, trending searches, suggestions, automatic search pagination, series details, episode list, in-panel WebCodecs decoding with quality switching, parallel startup loading, next-episode prefetch, per-episode resume history, a watchlist, and saved playback preferences. The panel talks only to this plugin's own background service over a loopback-only HTTP channel; the background uses the unofficial anonymous openhongguo SDK to read public catalogue and playback data. No account, no upload, no host data access.

The panel talks only to this plugin's own background service over a loopback-only HTTP channel; the background uses the unofficial anonymous openhongguo SDK to read public catalogue and playback data. No account, no upload, no host data access.
description.zh-CN: 红果短剧面板：推荐、排行、分类筛选、热搜、输入联想、搜索触底加载、详情、分集、本机 WebCodecs 解码播放与清晰度切换、起播并行读取、下一集预加载、逐集续播历史、收藏追剧与播放偏好记忆。面板只与本插件自己的后台服务通信（仅监听 127.0.0.1 的回环 HTTP 通道）；后台使用非官方匿名 SDK openhongguo 读取红果短剧的公开目录与播放数据。不登录账号、不上传任何数据、不读取宿主数据。
description.zh-TW: 紅果短劇面板：推薦、排行、分類篩選、熱搜、輸入聯想、搜尋觸底載入、詳情、分集、本機 WebCodecs 解碼播放與清晰度切換、起播並行讀取、下一集預載入、逐集續播歷史、收藏追劇與播放偏好記憶。面板只與本外掛自己的後台服務通訊（僅監聽 127.0.0.1 的回環 HTTP 通道）；後台使用非官方匿名 SDK openhongguo 讀取紅果短劇的公開目錄與播放資料。不登入帳號、不上傳任何資料、不讀取宿主資料。
